_comment: Use Case 2 workflow configuration. routing: which team an incoming instruction is assigned to, per transaction type ('Automatically route incoming client instructions to the designated Investment or Operations Team per the configured workflow'). correlation_identifiers: the identifiers documents may be correlated on, in priority order, straight from the proposal ('Portfolio Code / Name, Client Name, Transaction Date, Trade ID / Transaction Reference, Transaction Amount, and Security Name / Code'). date_tolerance_days: how far apart transaction dates may be for two documents to still correlate on the composite key. audit_folder_name: configurable audit-folder naming convention using {portfolio_code}, {transaction_id}, {transaction_date} placeholders.
